name: Release Matcher

settings.label: Release Index URL
settings.description: Optional: base URL of a compatible release index server (HTTPS or localhost). Leave blank to run the on-device matcher against Feed URLs below.

settings.label: Feed URLs (On-Device)
settings.description: Comma-separated RSS 2.0, Torznab 1.3, or JSON feed URLs queried live on your device. Supports {query}, {anilistId}, {malId}, {anidbId}, and {episode} placeholders.

settings.label: Fetch AniZip mappings
settings.description: Fetch and cache AniList-to-AniDB/TVDB episode mappings locally for more accurate season and episode matching.

description: Runs Shiru's full episode matcher, verifier, and ranker locally inside the extension worker (from your configured RSS/Torznab/JSON feeds) or connects to a compatible Release Index URL.
